page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 4 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 959 GB SSD, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps. The virtualization layer is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.i2.xlarge operates in the lower tiers of performance. The Intel Xeon 8163 CPU scored in the bottom 25% for both single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, as well as the PassMark CPU suite. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 163.34 GB/sec (bottom 25%), which drops to 19.71 GB/sec for large uncached blocks (bottom 10%). Computational tasks such as gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also fall into the bottom 10% of performance.

Given the high local SSD storage capacity of 959 GB and 32 GB of RAM paired with lower-tier CPU performance, this instance represents a specific resource density tradeoff. It is designed for workloads that require significant local storage space and moderate memory capacity but do not demand high CPU throughput. Appropriate workloads include basic database operations, caching layers, and local file processing where storage capacity is prioritized over raw computational speed.
